passages.note: Bill overview names Kolodin as prime sponsor of HB2785 (2024), an omnibus election-administration bill whose short title includes identification alongside canvass, recounts and ballots.

passages.provision_quote: aT ANY VOTING LOCATION THE VOTER MAY CHOOSE TO PROVIDE IDENTIFICATION WHEN PRESENTING THE VOTER'S MAILED EARLY BALLOT, AND IF SO THE ELECTION OFFICIAL SHALL: ( a ) REQUIRE THE VOTER TO PRESENT IDENTIFICATION THAT COMPLIES WITH PARAGRAPH 1 OF THIS SUBSECTION.
passages.note: The bill adds an optional path letting a mail-ballot voter show identification at a voting location instead of signature verification, alongside unrelated clauses on precincts, sample ballots, canvass deadlines and recounts.
House Third Reading shows Kolodin voting Yea on final passage of the omnibus bill.

rows.reasoning: Kolodin prime-sponsored and voted Yea on HB2785 (2024), an omnibus election-administration bill covering precinct boundaries, sample ballots, early-ballot processing, signature verification, canvass deadlines and recounts, with one clause newly letting a mail voter choose to show identification at a voting location instead of signature verification. Because the bill is multi-subject and no statement of his ties the vote or sponsorship to that specific clause, it shows only a direction toward added identification checks and does not establish 'Require photo ID in person and an ID number on every mail ballot' or any other served rung.
